blurb: Guests can book private charters on a traditional schooner or a classic motor boat departing from Boston Harbor Marina near Olympia. Charters include sailing trips of various durations and times of day, with a maximum of six passengers per trip. Guests can bring their own snacks and drinks, and life jackets are provided for children.
extraNote: Charters are flat rate per party, not per person · No refunds due to weather unless conditions are unsafe; rescheduling possible · Tipping crew is accepted but not expected; cash and Venmo accepted · Boston Harbor Marina, a quaint historic marina 10 minutes from downtown Olympia
